To find the stationary points of a function y = f(x), first, find the first derivative of the function, f'(x). Then, set the first derivative equal to zero and solve for x. To determine whether each stationary point is a maximum, minimum, or saddle point, find the second derivative of the function, f''(x), and evaluate it at each stationary point.
